Northeast Christian Groups Oppose FCRA Bill, Seek Scrapping

Christian groups from India's Northeast have urged the Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) to scrap the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill. Opposition Members of Parliament have also flagged gaps in the proceedings related to the bill. The groups are specifically concerned about the bill's implications and have called for its complete removal.
